2. Unicycle — wheel with spokes, rotating pedals, frame, seat
3. Juggling bottles — 3 bottles moving in a cascade pattern
4. Animations: wheel rotation, pedaling legs, juggling bottle arcs, bobbing body, tail swaying, slight up-and-down motion of the whole scene, moving ground/scrolling background, etc.

Let me think about how to animate the juggling. Classic approach: bottles follow arc paths using animateMotion with staggered start times. A 3-ball cascade can be approximated by each bottle following a figure-eight-ish path, or more simply: each bottle goes up in an arc from one hand to the other, staggered by 1/3 of the period.

Simple approach: 3 bottles, each with an animateMotion along a path that arcs from left hand to right hand and back (like a loop). In a cascade, balls cross: thrown from right hand to left in a high arc, then left to right. Each ball's full cycle: arc right→left, then arc left→right. Use a path like M start ... two arcs. Stagger each bottle by period/3.
